dialogue.t: Did... did you just feel the power of Geo?
Your connection to the elements is so different from the Vision bearers'! Seems like you can physically switch between elements...
If so, then you just need to make an offering to a Statue of The Seven and the elements will respond — just like they did in Mondstadt.
We're now in Liyue, which is ruled over by the Geo Archon. That's why the statues here look a bit different.
If you ever miss using your Anemo powers, you can just get them back from a Statue of The Seven in Mondstadt.
